The Turkish version of the EQ-5D is considered a valid instrument for assessing quality of life in patients with acute coronary syndrome. The results suggest that it provides independent prognostic information for survival, which supports its use in routine clinical practice.

In summary, based on the retrieved matches, the Turkish version of the EQ-5D appears to be a reliable and effective tool for evaluating patients' quality of life and predicting long-term outcomes in those with acute coronary syndrome.
